question: In March 2025, which day was celebrated to promote the use of generic medicines?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jan Aushadhi Diwas**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jan Aushadhi Diwas** is celebrated annually on **March 7th** to create awareness and promote the use of generic medicines.
 
• The initiative is part of the **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)**, a government scheme launched to provide affordable and quality medicines to all citizens.
 
• Generic medicines, which are distributed through Jan Aushadhi Kendras, are **50% to 90% cheaper** than branded medicines, ensuring affordability for the general public.
 
• Jan Aushadhi Kendras serve as a crucial step towards **accessible healthcare** by offering medicines at reduced costs, benefiting especially the economically weaker sections.
 
• In March 2025, Jan Aushadhi Diwas was celebrated to emphasize the role of generic medicines in reducing healthcare costs and improving accessibility across India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Generic Medicines:**

 
 
• Generic medicines are drugs that are chemically identical to branded drugs but are sold under their chemical name rather than a brand name.
 
• They are approved by the regulatory authorities for their efficacy, safety, and quality.
 
• Generic medicines help reduce the financial burden of healthcare on the population.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP):**
 
 
• Launched in 2008 and revamped under the leadership of PM Narendra Modi, PMBJP aims to provide affordable medicines through a network of Jan Aushadhi Kendras.
 
• These Kendras are functional across the country, with over 9,000 outlets as of 2023.
 
• The program ensures the availability of quality medicines certified by the Bureau of Pharma PSUs of India (BPPI).
 
 
 
• **Health Impact:**
 
 
• Jan Aushadhi Kendras play a critical role in improving healthcare access for low-income and rural communities.
 
• They contribute towards reducing the financial stress related to medical expenses, enabling better health outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Awareness Campaigns:**
 
 
• Events like Jan Aushadhi Diwas are used to spread information about generic medicines and their benefits.
 
• These campaigns aim to break misconceptions about the efficacy of generic drugs and encourage public trust.
